sqlMap.select: SELECT A.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(A.DOB,'yyyy-MM-dd') DOB, B.LOCAL_NAME, B.CHINESE_PINYIN, B.EMPID, A.FINAL_DEGREE_CODE, BE.CONTENT FINAL_DEGREE_CODE_NAME, A.SEXCODE, BF.CONTENT SEXCODE_NAME, A.NATION_CODE, BH.CONTENT NATION_CODE_NAME, A.NATIONALITY_CODE, BI.CONTENT NATIONALITY_CODE_NAME, A.BORNPLACE_CODE, BJ.CONTENT BORNPLACE_CODE_NAME, A.POLITY_CODE, BK.CONTENT POLITY_CODE_NAME, A.MARITAL_STATUS_CODE, BL.CONTENT MARITAL_STATUS_CODE_NAME, A.REG_TYPE_CODE, BM.CONTENT REG_TYPE_CODE_NAME, A.EMAIL, A.HOME_PHONE, A.OFFICE_PHONE, A.CELLPHONE, A.HOUSING_STATE_CODE, BN.CONTENT HOUSING_STATE_CODE_NAME, A.REG_PLACE, A.IDCARD_NO, A.LEGAL_DOCUMENTS_ADDRESS, A.HOME_ADDRESS FROM ESS_PERSONAL_INFO A, HR_EMPLOYEE B, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BF, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BH, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BI, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BJ, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BK, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BL, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BM, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BN WHERE A.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND A.PERSON_ID = B.PERSON_ID(+) AND A.FINAL_DEGREE_CODE = BE.NO(+) AND A.SEXCODE = BF.NO(+) AND A.NATION_CODE = BH.NO(+) AND A.NATIONALITY_CODE = BI.NO(+) AND A.BORNPLACE_CODE = BJ.NO(+) AND A.POLITY_CODE = BK.NO(+) AND A.MARITAL_STATUS_CODE = BL.NO(+) AND A.REG_TYPE_CODE = BM.NO(+) AND A.HOUSING_STATE_CODE = BN.NO(+) AND BE.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BF.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BH.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BI.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BJ.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BK.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BL.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BM.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BN.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#

SELECT A.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(A.DOB,'yyyy-MM-dd') DOB, B.LOCAL_NAME, B.CHINESE_PINYIN, B.EMPID, A.FINAL_DEGREE_CODE, BE.CONTENT FINAL_DEGREE_CODE_NAME, A.SEXCODE, BF.CONTENT SEXCODE_NAME, A.NATION_CODE, BH.CONTENT NATION_CODE_NAME, A.NATIONALITY_CODE, BI.CONTENT NATIONALITY_CODE_NAME, A.BORNPLACE_CODE, BJ.CONTENT BORNPLACE_CODE_NAME, A.POLITY_CODE, BK.CONTENT POLITY_CODE_NAME, A.MARITAL_STATUS_CODE, BL.CONTENT MARITAL_STATUS_CODE_NAME, A.REG_TYPE_CODE, BM.CONTENT REG_TYPE_CODE_NAME, A.EMAIL, A.HOME_PHONE, A.OFFICE_PHONE, A.CELLPHONE, A.HOUSING_STATE_CODE, BN.CONTENT HOUSING_STATE_CODE_NAME, A.REG_PLACE, A.IDCARD_NO, A.LEGAL_DOCUMENTS_ADDRESS, A.HOME_ADDRESS FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO A, HR_EMPLOYEE B, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BF, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BH, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BI, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BJ, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BK, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BL, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BM, SY_GLOBAL_NAME BN WHERE A.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND A.PERSON_ID = B.PERSON_ID(+) AND A.FINAL_DEGREE_CODE = BE.NO(+) AND A.SEXCODE = BF.NO(+) AND A.NATION_CODE = BH.NO(+) AND A.NATIONALITY_CODE = BI.NO(+) AND A.BORNPLACE_CODE = BJ.NO(+) AND A.POLITY_CODE = BK.NO(+) AND A.MARITAL_STATUS_CODE = BL.NO(+) AND A.REG_TYPE_CODE = BM.NO(+) AND A.HOUSING_STATE_CODE = BN.NO(+) AND BE.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BF.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BH.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BI.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BJ.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BK.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BL.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BM.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND BN.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#

SELECT EDUC_NO educationNo, EMPID empID, SUBJECT subjectCode, B.CODE_NAME subject, B.CODE_EN_NAME englishSubject, B.CODE_KOR_NAME korSubject, DEGREE_CODE degreeCode, C.CODE_NAME DEGREE, C.CODE_EN_NAME englishDegree, C.CODE_KOR_NAME korDegree, DEGREE_TYPE degreeType, INSTITUTION_NAME institutionName, RANK rank, EDUC_CARD_NO eduCardNo, SCHOOL_ADDRESS schoolAddress, TO_CHAR(START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') startDate, TO_CHAR(END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') endDate, TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')creatDate, A.CREATED_BY creatorID, TO_CHAR(A.UPDATE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')modifyDate, A.UPDATED_BY modifierID, A.ORDERNO orderNo, A.ACTIVITY activity FROM HR_EDUCATION A, SY_CODE B, SY_CODE C WHERE A.EMPID = #EMPID# AND B.CODE_ID(+) = A.SUBJECT AND C.CODE_ID(+) = A.DEGREE_CODE order by startDate desc
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EDUCATION A, SY_CODE B, SY_CODE C WHERE A.EMPID = #EMPID# AND B.CODE_ID(+) = A.SUBJECT AND C.CODE_ID(+) = A.DEGREE_CODE
SELECT A.PERSON_ID, A.CELLPHONE, A.HOME_ADDRESS, A.EMAIL, A.EMPLOYEE_ENGLISH_NAME ENGLISH_NAME FROM ESS_PERSONAL_INFO A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
SELECT A.PERSON_ID, A.CELLPHONE, A.HOME_ADDRESS, A.EMAIL, B.ENGLISH_NAME FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO A, HR_EMPLOYEE B WHERE A.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND A.PERSON_ID = B.PERSON_ID(+)

SELECT AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID, AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR, AR_DETAIL.DATE_TYPE, AR_DETAIL.AR_MONTH_STR, AR_DETAIL.ITEM_NO, CASE WHEN AR_DETAIL.ITEM_NO = '141440' THEN (select MIN(NVL(to_char(t.r_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '')) from AR_MAC_RECORDS_$interCpnyID$ t where t.person_id = AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID and to_char(t.r_time, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR and t.door_type = 'IN') ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(AR_DETAIL.FROM_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') END FROMTIME, CASE WHEN AR_DETAIL.ITEM_NO = '141440' THEN (select MAX(NVL(to_char(t.r_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '')) from AR_MAC_RECORDS_$interCpnyID$ t where t.person_id = AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID and to_char(t.r_time, 'YYYY/MM/DD') = AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR and t.door_type = 'OUT') ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(AR_DETAIL.TO_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') END TOTIME, AR_DETAIL.SHIFT_NO, AR_DETAIL.QUANTITY, AR_DETAIL.UNIT UNIT, AR_DETAIL.LOCK_YN, GET_DAILY_STATUS(AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR, #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#, AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID) status, E.EMPID, E.LOCAL_NAME, (SELECT DEPTNO FROM HR_EMP_HISTORY_STATUS B WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND PERSON_ID = AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID AND B.DATE_STR = AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR ) DEPTNO, get_dept_name((SELECT DEPTNO FROM HR_EMP_HISTORY_STATUS B WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND PERSON_ID = AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID AND B.DATE_STR = AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR ), 'zh') DEPTNAME, get_global_name(AR_DETAIL.SHIFT_NO, 'zh') SHIFT_NAME, get_global_name(AR_DETAIL.ITEM_NO, 'zh') ITEM_NAME FROM AR_DETAIL_LASTMONTH_$interCpnyID$ AR_DETAIL, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE E.LOCAL_NAME <> 'admin' AND E.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND E.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID# AND AR_DATE_STR >= #sDate:VARCHAR# AND AR_DATE_STR <= #eDate:VARCHAR# ORDER BY AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR, AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AR_DETAIL_LASTMONTH_$interCpnyID$ AR_DETAIL, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE E.LOCAL_NAME <> 'admin' AND AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND E.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID# AND AR_DATE_STR >= #sDate:VARCHAR# AND AR_DATE_STR <= #eDate:VARCHAR# ORDER BY AR_DETAIL.AR_DATE_STR, AR_DETAIL.PERSON_ID
